reporting-org.narrative: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development

title.narrative: Green Cities 2 W2 - Osh Electric Public Transport

description.narrative: The provision of a sovereign loan of up to € 14.7 million to the Kyrgyz Republic in two tranches - Tranche I (committed) of up to € 9.0 million and Tranche II (uncommitted) of up to € 5.7 million. The funds to be on-lent to the Osh city for the benefit of the Osh City Municipal Autotransport Company to finance the modernisation of electric public transport in the city. The project is co-financed by an investment grant of € 8.3 million to be provided in two tranches: Tranche I of up to € 5.0 million from the EBRD Shareholder Special Fund (SSF) and Tranche II of up to € 3.3 million from an international donor or the SSF. The Project will allow to integrate a new residential area of the city into the municipal public transport network, improving service quality and reliability. It will further contribute to a transport modal shift from using private vehicles towards inclusive public transport. The Project is consistent with (i) the Green Economy Transition (the "GET") approach (BDS20-082/F) through investment into "low-carbon and sustainable transport system", (ii) the MEI Sector Strategy (BDS19-069(F)) direction towards "switch to less carbon-intensive solutions", (iii) the Country Strategy for Kyrgyz Republic (BDS/KY/19-01/F) focus on "improved performance, service delivery and sustainability of municipal infrastructure", (iv) EBRD's Equality of Opportunity Strategy (BDS21-134(F)) and (v) EBRD's Strategy for the Promotion of Gender Equality (BDS21-133(F)). The Project also contributes to UN Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) 5. Gender Equality,SDG9. Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure, SDG11. Sustainable Cities and Communities,and to SDG 17. Partnerships for the SDGs.
